title: Entrepreneurship and Economic Development
abstract: Chapter 8 of Acs & Szerb's 'Global Entrepreneurship and Development Index 2010' (Edward Elgar). Develops the methodology and country rankings of the Global Entrepreneurship and Development Index. No publisher-side chapter abstract available.
summary_en: Chapter 8 of the Edward Elgar volume Global Entrepreneurship and Development Index 2010 develops the GEDI methodology that combines individual-level entrepreneurship indicators with country-level institutional moderators to produce a comparable cross-country entrepreneurship index. The chapter explains the construction (component sub-indices for attitudes, abilities, aspirations) and applies it to country rankings. The methodology becomes the foundation for subsequent annual GEDI reports widely cited in entrepreneurship-policy circles.
data_used: Global Entrepreneurship Monitor (GEM) individual-level survey responses combined with country-level institutional indicators from the World Bank, World Economic Forum, and Heritage Foundation, covering ~70+ countries for 2010.
policy_relevance: GEDI rankings are referenced by the European Commission DG-GROW, OECD, and national entrepreneurship-policy bodies including Hungary's ITM and KKM. The chapter explains the methodology underlying those references, useful for analysts at the Pénzügyminisztérium and HIPA when interpreting Hungary's GEDI position.
